name: comp-288

frames.best_why: The bar is shown largest and unobstructed, with the tick, message, View, Undo and close cross all legible.

tagline: A green tick confirms the send, with View and Undo links on the same line.
summary: A slim success notification. A green circled check precedes a one-line confirmation, followed by two underlined-on-hover text actions and a quiet close cross.
appearance: A narrow bordered strip with a soft shadow holds a small green circled tick, a short pale message, then the words View and Undo in matching weight divided by a grey dot, and a small X at the right end.
behaviour: Pointing at View or Undo underlines it, and hovering the close cross brightens it. Nothing is wired up, so clicking any of them has no effect.
demo_content: The message "Message sent" with View and Undo actions beside it.
use_when: An action just succeeded and people should see confirmation plus a quick way to reverse it.
avoid_when: The links and close are inert, so the undo promise is not connected to anything.
customise: The message and both action labels are typed into the file; the green tick and the width cap are fixed, and there are no props.
weight_why: A strip with a 16px icon and three small buttons.

a11y.note: View and Undo are real buttons that take focus, but nothing is wired to them or to the close cross.

issues: View, Undo and the close button have no handlers, so none of them responds to a click.
polish_why: Compact and well balanced, with restrained hover treatment on the actions.

title: Success With Undo Actions
